- **Core behavior:** Only captured payments can be refunded; partial refunds accumulate in `payment.refunded_amount`; over-refunds raise `refund_exceeds_captured`; status becomes `"refunded"` on full refund; returns the payment. Monetary math uses `round_money`/`ZERO` and `ensure_utc` normalizes `at`.
